ADVISORY MANDATES

All of Julius Baer’s investment expertise at your
fingertips.

Do you want to remain in full control of your investments, but sometimes struggle to keep on top of the
increasingly fast-paced and regulated world of financial markets? If so, then Julius Baer’s advisory

mandates could be the right solution for you.

Our advisory mandates offer expert investment strategies that are aligned with your financial situation
and objectives. You benefit from the support of our financial experts at every turn, while having the

final say on any investment decision.

Why opt for an advisory mandate?

Control

Maintain full control of all your investment decisions and get strategic and tactical advice to meet your

individual needs.

Dedicated specialist

Gain access to personal investment advice from your dedicated relationship manager.

Portfolio monitoring and research expertise
Benefit from our daily portfolio monitoring and research expertise by accessing or receiving our

publications.

How does it work?

Our first priority is to understand your needs and goals. To do this, we explore questions such as: What
matters to you? How involved do you want to be in your investments? What is your investment horizon?

We also determine your risk profile and explore investment themes you could be interested in.

Once we have completed this process, you define with your relationship manager the frequency of
interaction you wish to have. Your investment advisor or your relationship manager will then begin
actively supporting you with your investments. You will receive individual investment ideas tailored to
your portfolio, and naturally also have the flexibility to implement investment ideas of your choice.
Depending on the mandate you select, you will also be able to choose from a range of portfolio

monitoring options.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Can I personalise my advisory mandate? Vv

You have the possibility to choose between a range of investment strategies and profiles, which vary
depending on the model you select as well as your risk appetite and investment horizon. Ultimately,

you make every investment decision.
How frequent is the interaction with the bank? Vv

That depends entirely on your personal preferences, and on which mandate you ultimately choose.

Interaction can be monthly, weekly, or even daily.
